  {

    "absorber": "triple-cation/FAPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.93, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized flexible triple‐cation and FAPbI 3 composition PSCs yield a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.64% and 22.93%, respectively"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "An anion–cation synergetic strategy using a CuX layer inhibits Ni2+ oxidation and optimizes the buried perovskite/NiOx interface.", "anchor": "we develop an anion–cation synergetic strategy to inhibit Ni 2+ oxidation and optimize the buried interface of perovskites", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Optimized flexible triple-cation and FAPbI3 PSCs achieved PCEs of 21.64% and 22.93%, respectively.", "anchor": "the optimized flexible triple‐cation and FAPbI 3 composition PSCs yield a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.64% and 22.93%, respectively", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices maintained 85% of initial efficiency after 6000 h storage.", "anchor": "maintaining 85% of the initial efficiency even after 6000 h storage", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "FASnI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 16.0, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Devices optimized with CF3BTD achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 16.00%, with a certified efficiency of 15.06%"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 15.06, "unit": "%", "anchor": "with a certified efficiency of 15.06%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The reducing agent CF3BTD is introduced into the FASnI3 absorber to suppress Sn2+ oxidation and passivate bulk defects.", "anchor": "we introduced a multifunctional reducing agent—6‐(TrifluoroMethyl)benzo[b]thiophen‐3(2H)‐one 1,1‐Dioxide (CF3BTD)—into the FASnI 3 absorber layer", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "CF3BTD-optimized devices achieved a champion PCE of 16.00% and a certified efficiency of 15.06%.", "anchor": "Devices optimized with CF3BTD achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 16.00%, with a certified efficiency of 15.06%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retained over 90% of initial performance after 600 h of MPPT under white LED illumination.", "anchor": "retaining over 90% of their initial performance after 600 h under continuous white LED illumination at 100 mW cm −2 with maximum power point tracking in a nitrogen atmosphere", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CsPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 21.82, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized CsPbI 3 PSCs deliver a power conversion efficiency of 21.82%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "For larger‐area 1 cm 2 devices, the PCE remains high at 17.64%"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "AzCl wet-film post-treatment accelerates black-phase CsPbI3 formation by promoting DMA+ extraction during top-down crystallization.", "anchor": "we develop a wet‐film post‐treatment strategy using azetidinium chloride (AzCl) to accelerate black‐phase formation by promoting DMA + extraction in top‐down crystallization process", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Optimized CsPbI3 PSCs deliver 21.82% PCE and retain 94.7% of initial efficiency after 500 h in ambient air without encapsulation.", "anchor": "the optimized CsPbI 3 PSCs deliver a power conversion efficiency of 21.82% and retain 94.7% of their initial efficiency after 500 h in ambient air without encapsulation", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Under low-light conditions (2956 K, 1062 lux), the device PCE reaches 39.94%.", "anchor": "under low‐light conditions (2956 K, 1062 lux), the PCE reaches to 39.94%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite (1.77 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 28.63, "unit": "%", "anchor": "two-terminal all-perovskite tandem solar cells were fabricated, which demonstrated an impressive PCE of 28.63%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Phenylhydrazine derivatives in the perovskite solution modulate crystallization and inhibit iodide oxidation in WBG perovskite.", "anchor": "an effective strategy is introduced through the incorporation of phenylhydrazine derivatives into the perovskite solution", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Inverted single-junction 1.77 eV WBG PSCs obtained 20.75% PCE.", "anchor": "inverted single-junction WBG PSCs with a bandgap of 1.77 eV obtained a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.75%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Two-terminal all-perovskite tandem cells integrating the WBG subcell with mixed Sn-Pb subcells demonstrated 28.63% PCE.", "anchor": "two-terminal all-perovskite tandem solar cells were fabricated, which demonstrated an impressive PCE of 28.63%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite (1.68 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.25, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the L12‐CMCNa‐modified devices deliver a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.25% with a fill factor (FF) of 83.80%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The hydrophobically modified cellulose derivative L12-CMCNa enhances performance and stability of 1.68 eV wide-bandgap PSCs via interfacial engineering.", "anchor": "we report a novel hydrophobically modified cellulose derivative, L12‐CMCNa, that through interfacial engineering, markedly enhances the performance and stability of 1.68 eV wide‐bandgap perovskite solar cells (PSCs)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "L12-CMCNa-modified devices deliver a champion PCE of 23.25% with FF of 83.80%.", "anchor": "the L12‐CMCNa‐modified devices deliver a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.25% with a fill factor (FF) of 83.80%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices maintained over 90% of initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous one-sun operation (ISOS-L-1I).", "anchor": "the unencapsulated devices maintained over 90% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous one‐sun operation (ISOS‐L‐1I), 800 h of storage at 30% relative humidity (ISOS‐D‐1), and 1000 h of aging at 65°C (ISOS‐D‐2I)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "perovskite (1.55 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.12, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the corresponding 1.55 eV bandgap PSCs achieved the highest power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.12%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Monophosphonate-anchored M3PAICz-1 SAM shows advantages in surface wettability, compactness, film uniformity, energy level alignment, hole extraction, and defect passivation.", "anchor": "monophosphonate-anchored M3PAICz-1 demonstrates advantages in surface wettability, compactness, film uniformity, energy level alignment, hole extraction, and defect passivation", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "1.55 eV bandgap PSCs with M3PAICz-1 achieved a highest PCE of 26.12% with excellent air stability.", "anchor": "the corresponding 1.55 eV bandgap PSCs achieved the highest power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.12% and excellent air stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "M3PAICz-1 also enabled 1.68 eV wide-bandgap PSCs with 22.19% efficiency.", "anchor": "M3PAICz-1 also endowed 1.68 eV wide-bandgap (WBG) PSCs with an impressive efficiency of 22.19%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 20.55, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the TTA‐modified device achieves a remarkable power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.55%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The additive TTA modulates competitive bromine/iodine phase crystallization to achieve synchronous halogen crystallization in WBG perovskite.", "anchor": "we propose a synchronous halogen crystallization strategy utilizing a multifunctional additive, 4,4′,4″‐tricarboxyl triphenylamine (TTA), to modulate the bromine/iodine phase competitive crystallization", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The TTA-modified device achieves 20.55% PCE with an open-circuit voltage of 1.339 V.", "anchor": "the TTA‐modified device achieves a remarkable power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.55% with an open‐circuit voltage ( V OC ) of 1.339 V", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The unencapsulated device retains 90% of initial efficiency after 1050 h of ambient storage and shows a T90 lifetime of 750 h under ISOS-L-1.", "anchor": "the unencapsulated device retains 90% of its initial efficiency after 1050 h of storage in the ambient environment and exhibits an extended T 90 lifetime of 750 h under ISOS‐L‐1 conditions", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite (1.67 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.97, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving a power conversion efficiency of 22.97%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Aminoguanidine dihydrochloride is co-assembled with Me-4PACz to form an AH-SAM hole-transport layer.", "anchor": "we incorporate aminoguanidine dihydrochloride into the widely used Me-4PACz self‐assembled hole-transport layer, forming a co-assembled layer (AH-SAM)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The 1.67 eV WBG device reaches Voc of 1.27 V with a 0.40 V deficit and 22.97% PCE.", "anchor": "These improvements enable open-circuit voltage of 1.27 V for a 1.67 eV wide-bandgap perovskite device, demonstrating one of the lowest reported open-circuit voltage deficits (0.40 V), achieving a power conversion efficiency of 22.97%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 96% of initial efficiency after 1,000 h of MPPT under 1 sun illumination.", "anchor": "retaining 96% of the initial efficiency after 1,000 h of maximum power point tracking under 1 sun illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.17, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the MSB‐based PSCs achieved a champion PCE of 25.17%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The multifunctional molecule MSB is added to the perovskite precursor to delay crystallization and provide multi-site, long-term passivation.", "anchor": "we introduce a new multifunctional organic small molecule, 4‐(Methylsulfonyl)benzene‐carboximidamide hydrochloride (MSB), into the perovskite precursor solution", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "MSB-based PSCs achieved a champion PCE of 25.17% with over 1000 h T90 operational stability.", "anchor": "the MSB‐based PSCs achieved a champion PCE of 25.17% with over 1000 h T90 operational stability in addition to enhanced thermal and humidity stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "tandem_4T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite (1.67 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 30.97, "unit": "%", "anchor": "a mechanically stacked four-terminal perovskite/silicon tandem solar cell reaching 30.97% efficiency"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 23.42, "unit": "%", "anchor": "leading to a certified efficiency of 23.42%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A blended 2PACz/Me-4PACz SAM offers improved surface potential uniformity and interfacial energy alignment over individual SAMs.", "anchor": "a blended self-assembled monolayer of (2-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)ethyl)phosphonic acid (2PACz) and (4-(3,6-Dimethyl-9H-carbazol-9-yl)butyl)phosphonic acid (Me-4PACz) is developed, offering improved surface potential uniformity and interfacial energy alignment compared to individual SAMs", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Simulation analysis reveals elimination of interfacial energy barriers through precise energy-level tuning.", "anchor": "Interactions between the SAMs and ionic species are investigated with simulation analysis conducted, revealing the elimination of interfacial energy barriers through precise energy-level tuning", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "Inverted 1.67 eV PSCs exceed 24% efficiency with a certified FF of 86.8% and certified efficiency of 23.42%, enabling a 30.97% four-terminal perovskite/silicon tandem.", "anchor": "This strategy enables wide-bandgap (1.67 eV) perovskite solar cells with inverted structures with over 24% efficiency, an open-circuit voltage ( V oc ) of 1.268 V, and a certified fill factor (FF) of 86.8%, leading to a certified efficiency of 23.42%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": "2D/3D perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 29.73, "unit": "%", "anchor": "exhibit remarkable efficiencies of 29.73% (0.135 cm 2 ) and 28.77% (28.25% certified efficiency, 1.012 cm 2 )"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 28.25, "unit": "%", "anchor": "28.77% (28.25% certified efficiency, 1.012 cm 2 )"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1.012, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "28.77% (28.25% certified efficiency, 1.012 cm 2 )"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A 10 nm VTE-deposited spiro-OMeTAD layer achieves a 92.2% reduction in parasitic absorption and an 18.4% decrease in reflection losses.", "anchor": "Our results demonstrate that the 10-nm-thick spiro-OMeTAD layer significantly improves optical performance, achieving a 92.2% reduction in parasitic absorption and an 18.4% decrease in reflection losses", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The 2D/3D perovskite heterojunction improves molecular arrangement and hole extraction in the ultrathin spiro-OMeTAD.", "anchor": "the incorporation of the 2D/3D perovskite heterojunction facilitates improved molecular arrangement and enhanced surface uniformity of the ultrathin spiro-OMeTAD, leading to higher tolerance to interface defects and more efficient hole extraction", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "n-i-p perovskite/silicon TSCs with ultrathin spiro-OMeTAD exhibit efficiencies of 29.73% (0.135 cm2) and 28.77% (1.012 cm2, 28.25% certified).", "anchor": "n–i–p perovskite/silicon TSCs featuring ultrathin spiro-OMeTAD exhibit remarkable efficiencies of 29.73% (0.135 cm 2 ) and 28.77% (28.25% certified efficiency, 1.012 cm 2 ), along with improved stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "Pb-Sn mixed perovskite",
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Glutathione (GSH) is introduced as a natural redox shuttle in Pb-Sn mixed PSCs for regenerable antioxidation and crystallization regulation.", "anchor": "we introduce a natural redox shuttle glutathione (GSH) in Pb–Sn mixed PSCs, achieving regenerable antioxidation and crystallization regulation simultaneously", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Reversible GSH/GSSG redox reactions enable self-healing of Sn4+ and Sn0/Pb0 impurities at the perovskite interfaces.", "anchor": "The reversible redox reactions between GSH and glutathione disulfide (GSSG) enable the self-healing of Sn 4+ and Sn 0 /Pb 0 impurities, creating a regenerable antioxidation protective shell at the perovskite interfaces", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Strong coordination between GSH and perovskite regulates crystallization, optimizing nucleation and crystallization kinetics.", "anchor": "the strong coordination between GSH and perovskite regulates the crystallization process, optimizing the nucleation and crystallization kinetics", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  }
